page.overview:
Who is Jinju?

Not long before Aang froze himself in an iceberg, he created and taught his peers a new airbending trick, the air scooter, which was a sphere of air upon which one could ride, and the other children soon created an accompanying game. When Aang asked to play, he was denied as the others felt that his being the Avatar would give his team an unfair advantage. As Aang left, Jinju was the last to be picked, though neither team showed interest.
